## 现有大纲 manifest

```json
{
  "project": "vllm-omni",
  "head": "900a7f0813d0482811b0e4dfd3cf7deabbe2429f",
  "rationale": "vLLM-Omni 是在 vLLM 基础上扩展的「全模态（omni-modality）推理与服务框架」，其核心特色是 AR+DiT 多阶段、全解耦（OmniConnector + Orchestrator）的运行时。学习路线遵循「先会用 → 再懂机制 → 后能扩展」的递进。入门层 U1 从项目定位、安装、源码地图到离线/在线快速上手，让读者先跑通第一个模型；U2 讲清 vLLM-Omni 如何通过 patch.py、配置体系、输入输出数据结构扩展 vLLM，这是理解整个项目的地基。进阶层用三个单元分别拆解三大核心子系统：U3 多阶段运行时与编排（AsyncOmniEngine/Orchestrator/Stage 进程/OmniConnector/OmniCoordinator），U4 AR 模块（scheduler/worker/model runner/多模态输出），U5 Diffusion 模块（engine/sched/executor/worker/pipeline），对应架构图中的 Entrypoints、AR、Diffusion、OmniConnector；U6 讲在线服务 API。专家层 U7 集中讲 Diffusion 加速（注意力后端/并行注意力/缓存/并行策略/请求级与连续批处理），U8 讲量化、多硬件平台与性能剖析，U9 讲三类模型（Diffusion / Omni 多阶段 / TTS）的扩展开发与实验特性，U10 讲 L1–L5 测试体系与 CI 工程实践。讲义间依赖按「入门→机制→子系统→加速→扩展→工程」串成线性主干，每个加速/扩展主题都依赖其对应的子系统讲义，确保读者始终结合真实源码循序渐进。",
  "units": [
    {
      "id": "u1",
      "title": "入门：认识 vLLM-Omni 与第一次运行",
      "level": "beginner",
      "order": 1,
      "lectures": [
        {
          "id": "u1-l1",
          "title": "vLLM-Omni 是什么：全模态推理框架全景",
          "order": 1,
          "filename": "u1-l1-project-overview.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "介绍 vLLM-Omni 的定位、要解决的问题（非自回归结构、非文本输出、多模态），以及它与上游 vLLM 的关系，建立全局认知。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 vLLM-Omni 相对于 vLLM 扩展的三大目标：非文本输出、非自回归结构、与 vLLM 核心兼容",
            "识别代表模型的三种组合：DiT 为主（Qwen-Image）、AR 为主（BAGEL）、AR+DiT（Qwen-Omni）",
            "说出 OmniRouter、EntryPoints、AR、Diffusion、OmniConnector 五大组件的职责"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "README.md",
            "docs/design/architecture_overview.md",
            "vllm_omni/__init__.py"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "README About / Latest News",
            "architecture_overview.md 的 Goals 与 Key Components",
            "vllm_omni/__init__.py 的模块说明注释"
          ],
          "practice_task": "阅读 architecture_overview.md 后，用自己的话画出一张 AR+DiT 模型（如 Qwen3-Omni）在 vLLM-Omni 中的请求流转草图，标出 Thinker/Talker/Code2wav 与 Orchestrator 的位置。",
          "depends_on": [],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u1-l2",
          "title": "安装与环境：从源码安装 vLLM-Omni",
          "order": 2,
          "filename": "u1-l2-installation.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "讲解在不同硬件（CUDA/ROCm/NPU/XPU）上的安装方式、Python 与 vLLM 版本对齐要求，以及 setup.py/pyproject.toml 的关键约定。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 CUDA 与 ROCm 下从源码安装 vLLM-Omni 的命令",
            "理解 vLLM 与 vLLM-Omni 主次版本必须对齐的原因及版本告警机制",
            "了解 pyproject.toml 中 console_script（vllm-omni）与可选依赖的组织方式"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "docs/getting_started/quickstart.md",
            "docs/getting_started/installation/README.md",
            "pyproject.toml",
            "setup.py"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "quickstart.md 的 Installation 段",
            "pyproject.toml 的 [project.scripts] 与依赖声明",
            "vllm_omni/version.py 的版本对齐告警逻辑"
          ],
          "practice_task": "在本机（或容器）按 quickstart 完成 CUDA 源码安装，运行 `python -c \"import vllm_omni; print(vllm_omni.__version__)\"` 确认版本，并故意装一个版本不匹配的 vLLM 观察告警。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l1"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u1-l3",
          "title": "源码地图：目录结构与包布局",
          "order": 3,
          "filename": "u1-l3-directory-map.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "梳理 vllm_omni 包目录、docs/examples/recipes/tests/benchmarks 等顶层目录的职责，建立后续阅读的「地图」。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 vllm_omni/ 下 entrypoints、engine、diffusion、distributed、config、platforms、quantization、worker、core 等目录的职责",
            "区分 examples/offline_inference 与 examples/online_serving 的用途",
            "了解 docs/design 与 docs/contributing 中可参考的设计与贡献文档"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "vllm_omni/__init__.py",
            "README.md"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "vllm_omni 包子目录（entrypoints/engine/diffusion/distributed/config/platforms/quantization/worker/core）",
            "examples/offline_inference 与 examples/online_serving 目录",
            "docs/design 与 docs/contributing 目录"
          ],
          "practice_task": "用树形图列出 vllm_omni/ 下的一级目录，并为每个目录写一句不超过 15 字的职责说明，形成一张速查表。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l1"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u1-l4",
          "title": "离线推理初体验：用 Omni 类生成图像",
          "order": 4,
          "filename": "u1-l4-offline-quickstart.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "通过 text_to_image 例子，演示如何用 Omni 类做离线批处理推理，理解 generate 的输入输出与多 prompt 自动批处理。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "会用 Omni(model=...).generate(prompt) 完成一次文生图",
            "理解 outputs[0].request_output.images 的输出结构",
            "知道 diffusion 场景下每个 prompt 是独立逻辑请求、运行时可自动批处理"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "docs/getting_started/quickstart.md",
            "examples/offline_inference/text_to_image/text_to_image.py",
            "vllm_omni/entrypoints/omni.py"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "quickstart.md 的 Offline Inference 段",
            "Omni.generate 的入参与返回（OmniRequestOutput）",
            "text_to_image.py 的核心调用链"
          ],
          "practice_task": "运行 examples/offline_inference/text_to_image/text_to_image.py，传入 3 条不同 prompt，将生成的 3 张图片保存并对照输出，体会「多 prompt 自动批处理」。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l2",
            "u1-l3"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u1-l5",
          "title": "在线服务初体验：vllm serve --omni 与 OpenAI 兼容 API",
          "order": 5,
          "filename": "u1-l5-online-quickstart.md",
          "level": "beginner",
          "topic": "演示用 `vllm serve --omni` 启动 OpenAI 兼容服务，并用 curl 调用 /v1/chat/completions 完成文生图，理解 CLI 拦截机制。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 `vllm serve <model> --omni --port 8091` 的启动方式",
            "理解 main.py 如何通过 --omni 标志拦截并接管 vLLM 命令",
            "会用 curl 调用 /v1/chat/completions 并解析返回的图像 base64"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "docs/getting_started/quickstart.md",
            "vllm_omni/entrypoints/cli/main.py",
            "vllm_omni/entrypoints/cli/serve.py"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "quickstart.md 的 Online Serving 段",
            "main.py 的 --omni 拦截与子命令注册逻辑",
            "serve.py 的 cmd_init 与启动流程"
          ],
          "practice_task": "启动 Z-Image-Turbo 的 --omni 服务，用 quickstart 中的 curl 命令生成一张图并保存为 png；再尝试去掉 --omni 观察命令行为差异。",
          "depends_on": [

          ],
          "action": "new"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "u2",
      "title": "核心抽象：如何扩展 vLLM",
      "level": "intermediate",
      "order": 2,
      "lectures": [
        {
          "id": "u2-l1",
          "title": "patch 机制：vLLM-Omni 如何无缝改写 vLLM",
          "order": 1,
          "filename": "u2-l1-patch-mechanism.md",
          "level": "intermediate",
          "topic": "讲解 vllm_omni/patch.py 的 monkey-patch 思路与 __init__.py 的注册时机，理解「修改（🟡）+ 新增（🔴）」扩展模型。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 patch.py 在 import 早期被加载的时机与作用",
            "掌握 patch 对 ModelConfig.is_mm_prefix_lm、NVFP4 weight_scale、RequestStatus 的具体改写",
            "区分 vLLM 组件被「修改」与被「新增」两类扩展"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "vllm_omni/__init__.py",
            "vllm_omni/patch.py"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "__init__.py 的 patch 与 transformers_utils 注册顺序",
            "patch.py 中的 _patched_is_mm_prefix_lm / _clamp_nvfp4_weight_scale_nans / RequestStatus 扩展",
            "MM_PREFIX_LM_MODELS 列表"
          ],
          "practice_task": "在 patch.py 中找到一处 monkey-patch，画出「原方法 → 被包装后的方法」的调用关系图，并解释如果不打这个补丁会发生什么。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l3"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u2-l2",
          "title": "配置体系：从单模型到多阶段 Stage 配置",
          "order": 2,
          "filename": "u2-l2-config-system.md",
          "level": "intermediate",
          "topic": "讲解 config 目录下的三类配置：OmniModelConfig（模型级）、omni_config.py（结构化多阶段）、stage_config.py（YAML 部署），理解一个请求如何被声明成多个 stage。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 OmniModelConfig 相对 vLLM ModelConfig 新增的 stage_id、engine_output_type、stage_connector_config 等字段",
            "掌握 VllmOmniConfig / VllmOmniARStageConfig / VllmOmniDiffusionStageConfig 的层级关系",
            "区分结构化 omni_config 与 legacy stage_config（StageType/StageExecutionType）的用途"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "vllm_omni/config/model.py",
            "vllm_omni/config/omni_config.py",
            "vllm_omni/config/stage_config.py",
            "vllm_omni/config/config_factory.py"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "OmniModelConfig 的关键字段",
            "VllmOmniConfig 顶层容器与各 StageConfig 子类",
            "StageConfigFactory 的构建入口"
          ],
          "practice_task": "为一个假想的「AR + Diffusion」两阶段模型，手写一段最小的结构化 stage 配置（含 stage_type、parallel、connector），并说明每个 stage 用哪个 StageConfig 子类。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u2-l1"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u2-l3",
          "title": "输入输出数据结构：OmniPromptType 与 OmniRequestOutput",
          "order": 3,
          "filename": "u2-l3-io-data-structures.md",
          "level": "intermediate",
          "topic": "讲解 inputs/data.py 中的多模态 prompt 类型与 outputs 中的统一输出结构，理解跨阶段数据如何在内存中表达。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 OmniPromptType 联合类型及其各成员（OmniTextPrompt/OmniEmbedsPrompt/OmniCustomPrompt 等）",
            "理解 prompt_embeds、additional_information 在阶段间传递的作用",
            "掌握 OmniRequestOutput / OmniModelRunnerOutput / OmniConnectorOutput 的层级与用途"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "vllm_omni/inputs/data.py",
            "vllm_omni/outputs/__init__.py",
            "vllm_omni/engine/__init__.py"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "inputs/data.py 的各 Prompt dataclass 与 OmniDiffusionSamplingParams",
            "outputs 的 OmniRequestOutput / OmniModelRunnerOutput / OmniConnectorOutput",
            "engine/__init__.py 的 PromptEmbedsPayload / AdditionalInformationPayload / OmniEngineCoreRequest"
          ],
          "practice_task": "构造一个包含文本 + 多模态数据 + additional_information 的 OmniPromptType 字典，跟踪它如何被序列化为 OmniEngineCoreRequest，写出关键字段的映射关系。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l4",
            "u2-l1"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "u3",
      "title": "多阶段运行时与编排",
      "level": "intermediate",
      "order": 3,

        {

          "filename": "u3-l1-async-omni-architecture.md",
          "level": "intermediate",
          "topic": "基于 Qwen3-Omni 示例，讲解 API 层（Omni/AsyncOmni）、Engine 代理层（AsyncOmniEngine）、Orchestration 层、Communication 层、Execution 层的五层架构与一次 generate 的执行流。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 AsyncOmni / Omni / AsyncOmniEngine / Orchestrator 的职责分层",
            "理解 request_queue / output_queue（janus.Queue）的线程间通信",
            "跟踪一次 generate 请求从 add_request 到 yield OmniRequestOutput 的 8 步流程"

            "vllm_omni/entrypoints/async_omni.py",
            "vllm_omni/entrypoints/omni_base.py",
            "vllm_omni/engine/async_omni_engine.py"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [

            "AsyncOmniEngine 的 add_request / try_get_output 接口",
            "OmniBase 的共享逻辑（_run_generation / _compute_final_stage_id）"
          ],
          "practice_task": "对照 async_omni_architecture.md 的执行流，为一次「text → audio」请求标注每个箭头步骤发生在哪个文件/类中，形成一份执行流注释表。",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l4",
            "u2-l1"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u3-l2",
          "title": "Orchestrator：跨阶段请求编排",
          "order": 2,
          "filename": "u3-l2-orchestrator.md",
          "level": "intermediate",
          "topic": "讲解后台 Orchestrator 线程如何轮询各 stage 输出、路由并前推到下一阶段，以及 OrchestratorRequestState 的状态跟踪。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 Orchestrator 的 _request_handler 与 _orchestration_output_handler 两条处理路径",
            "掌握 _route_output 与 _forward_to_next_stage 的阶段前推逻辑",
            "理解 OrchestratorRequestState 如何跟踪每个请求的阶段进度"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "vllm_omni/engine/orchestrator.py",
            "vllm_omni/engine/orchestrator_monitor.py",
            "vllm_omni/engine/stage_pool.py"

            "stage_pool 与阶段副本管理"

          "depends_on": [
            "u3-l1"
          ],
          "action": "new"
        },
        {
          "id": "u3-l3",
          "title": "阶段进程与运行时：StageEngineCoreProc 与 StageRuntime",
          "order": 3,
          "filename": "u3-l3-stage-process-runtime.md",
          "level": "intermediate",
          "topic": "讲解每个 stage 作为独立 EngineCore 子进程的启动、ZMQ 通信、StageRuntime 的单机/分布式实现，以及 StageClient 的请求投递。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 StageEngineCoreProc 继承自 vLLM EngineCoreProc 并提供 run_stage_core 入口",
            "掌握 StageRuntime 的 StageRuntimeInfo 与单机/分布式工厂上下文",
            "理解 StageEngineCoreClient（ZMQ ROUTER/PULL + msgpack）如何把请求投递到 stage 进程"
          ],
          "source_files": [
            "vllm_omni/engine/stage_engine_core_proc.py",
            "vllm_omni/engine/stage_engine_core_proc_manager.py",
            "vllm_omni/engine/stage_runtime.py",
            "vllm_omni/engine/stage_client.py"
          ],
          "minimal_modules": [
            "StageEngineCoreProc 的 busy loop 与 run_stage_core",
            "StageRuntime 的 StageRuntimeInfo 与 StageRemoteFactoryContext",
            "StageClient 的 add_request_async / get_output_async"
          ],
          "practice_task": "梳理 stage 进程从启动到接收第一条请求的初始化链路（init_device → load_model → busy_loop → execute），标注每步发生在哪个类。",
          "depends_on": [

          ],
          "action": "new"

        {
          "id": "u3-l4",

          "filename": "u3-l4-omni-connectors.md",
          "level": "intermediate",
          "topic": "讲解 OmniConnectorBase 的 put/get 抽象、各类连接器（SharedMemory/Mooncake/Mori/Yuanrong）、工厂与适配器，以及 YAML 中如何为 stage 边缘指定连接器。",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 OmniConnectorBase 的 put/get 契约与 metadata 传递机制",
            "理解 SharedMemoryConnector（单机自动配置）与 Mooncake/Yuanrong（多节点 RDMA）的适用场景",

          "source_files": [
            "docs/design/feature/disaggregated_inference.md",
            "vllm_omni/distributed/omni_connectors/factory.py",

          "action": "new"

        {

          "title": "OmniCoordinator：副本注册与负载均衡",
          "order": 5,
          "filename": "u3-l5-omni-coordinator.md",
          "level": "advanced",
          "topic": "讲解分布式场景下 OmniCoordinator 如何作为中心协调者管理 stage 副本、心跳、负载均衡策略与 wire protocol 消息。",
```

# Upper bound on how long a request may sit in full-payload-input wait
# (the state ``OmniSchedulingCoordinator`` records via ``_waiting_since``)
# before the scheduler force-fails it.  Defends against stuck consumer-side
# requests when the producer drops a full-payload, send fails, or recv
# never arrives.  Override per-deployment via
# VLLM_OMNI_INPUT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_S; set <=0 to disable the safety net.
#
# Scope: this constant only covers the full-payload coordinator path
# (``input_coordinator``).  The async-chunk path uses
# ``chunk_transfer_adapter`` and is not affected by this constant.
_INPUT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_RAW = os.environ.get("VLLM_OMNI_INPUT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_S", "600")
try:
    DEFAULT_INPUT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_S: float = float(_INPUT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_RAW)
except ValueError:
    logger.warning(
        "Invalid VLLM_OMNI_INPUT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_S=%r; falling back to 600 seconds.",
        _INPUT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_RAW,
    )
    DEFAULT_INPUT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_S = 600.0


class OmniSchedulerMixin:
    """Shared scheduler helpers for omni-specific request handling."""

        self.input_coordinator = (

=== NEW DOC: async output materialization (head 120 lines) === # Async Omni Output Materialization ## Table of Contents 1. [Overview](#overview) 2. [Performance](#performance) 3. [Architecture](#architecture) 4. [Enabling the Feature](#enabling-the-feature) 5. [Compatibility and Fallbacks](#compatibility-and-fallbacks) 6. [Related Files](#related-files) ## Overview Async Omni output materialization moves CPU-side construction of `OmniModelRunnerOutput` out of the autoregressive (AR) decode critical path. It complements [Async Chunk](async_chunk.md): async chunk pipelines partial outputs between stages, while async output materialization prevents the construction of those partial outputs from blocking the next decode step. An AR stage must return sampled token IDs quickly because the scheduler needs them for the next decode step. However, an Omni stage can also produce hidden states, multimodal tensors, streaming inter-stage payloads, and connector metadata. Building these payloads can require device-to-host (D2H) copies, tensor slicing, flattening, and Python object construction. Without this feature, all of that work runs inline in `sample_tokens()`: ```text sample tokens -> update decode state -> copy hidden and multimodal outputs to CPU -> build per-request payloads -> build the streaming wire payload -> collect connector signals -> return sampled tokens -> launch the next decode step ``` With async output materialization, only work required by the next decode step stays on the critical path: ```text sample tokens -> update decode state -> snapshot output state and start asynchronous D2H copies -> register sampled tokens -> launch the next decode step background output path -> wait for the payload snapshot -> build per-request payloads -> build the streaming wire payload -> collect connector signals -> construct OmniModelRunnerOutput ``` This allows payload construction for step `N` to overlap with GPU decode work for step `N + 1`. It does not change model computation or generated output. !!! note "Platform and validation scope" The performance and correctness validation in this document covers CUDA and ROCm. This is a validation scope, not a runtime platform guard: XPU inherits `GPUARModelRunner`, and MUSA selects `GPUARWorker`, so those backends may enter the asynchronous path when its other guards pass. XPU and MUSA have not been validated for this optimization. Ascend NPU uses a separate `NPUARModelRunner` path that still constructs `OmniModelRunnerOutput` and drains connector output synchronously before wrapping the result as an asynchronous runner output.

Figure 1: Moving payload construction off the decode path reduces the observed gap between consecutive Talker steps from about 2.8 ms to 41 µs. Adapted from the Qwen3-Omni optimization blog .

For Qwen3-Omni, the feature is enabled for both AR stages: - **Thinker**: Defers hidden-state and multimodal payload materialization. - **Talker**: Runs its decode-state postprocess eagerly, then defers codec payload materialization. Because Code2Wav consumes codec codes rather than Talker hidden states, the Talker also skips unnecessary hidden-state D2H. - **Code2Wav**: Does not use this path because it is a generation stage rather than an AR stage. Qwen3-TTS uses the same mechanism in its AR Talker stage. The Talker updates the decode state it needs for the next step before returning, then constructs the codec payload for Code2Wav in the background. ## Performance In the controlled Qwen3-Omni optimization sweep, enabling async output materialization on top of CUDA Graph and async chunk produced the following results at concurrency 64: | Configuration | Request throughput | Mean audio TTFP | Mean audio RTF | |---|---:|---:|---:| | CUDA Graph + async chunk | 9.3 req/s | 655 ms | 0.63 | | + async output materialization | 11.3 req/s | 631 ms | 0.47 | | Change | **+22%** | **-4%** | **-25%** | The sweep used `Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct`, 640 Seed-TTS English prompts, and one replica each for Thinker, Talker, and Code2Wav. Async output materialization recovers throughput by removing CPU payload construction from the decode critical path without regressing time to first audio packet (TTFP). See the [Qwen3-Omni optimization blog](https://vllm.ai/blog/2026-07-01-qwen3-omni-optimization) for the complete benchmark methodology and results.

=== async output doc: Related Files + Enabling sections ===
for the complete benchmark methodology and results.

The implementation was also validated against the synchronous safe-copy path.
The text and audio output hashes matched, confirming that overlap does not
change the generated result. See
[PR #4476](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/pull/4476) for the
correctness and profiling details.

## Architecture

### Output Lifecycle

`OmniAsyncGPUModelRunnerOutput` extends vLLM's
`AsyncGPUModelRunnerOutput`. It preserves the existing asynchronous
sampled-token feedback while adding a background builder for the complete Omni
output.

The output lifecycle is:

1. `GPUARModelRunner.sample_tokens()` samples tokens and performs the
   bookkeeping required by the next decode step.
2. The runner snapshots step-local metadata such as request IDs, token spans,
   scheduler output, and query start locations.
3. CUDA payload tensors are cloned before reusable model or CUDA Graph buffers
   can be overwritten.
4. The cloned payload is copied to pinned CPU memory on a dedicated CUDA
   stream. A CUDA event records when the copy is ready.
5. `OmniAsyncGPUModelRunnerOutput` starts a background thread that waits for
   the payload event and builds `OmniModelRunnerOutput`.
6. The AR runner immediately registers the sampled-token CPU copy with the
   input batch and returns, allowing async scheduling to advance.
7. When the engine calls `get_output()`, it joins the background builder,
   propagates any builder exception, and finalizes sampled tokens and logprobs
   through the upstream output implementation.

```text
GPU / decode path                         Background output path

forward + sample
      |
      +-- clone output tensors
      +-- enqueue D2H copy --------------> wait for D2H event
      +-- register sampled tokens               |
      +-- return async output                    +-- slice per request
      |                                         +-- build multimodal payloads
next decode step                                +-- partition streaming payloads
                                                +-- build the wire payload
                                                +-- drain connector signals
                                                +-- build OmniModelRunnerOutput
```

### Safe State Snapshots

The next scheduler step can mutate runner state while the background builder is
still active. Most step-local builder inputs are therefore detached snapshots.
The snapshotted state includes:

- scheduler token counts and speculative-token metadata
- request IDs and request-to-batch-index mappings
- sampled token IDs, logprobs, and prompt logprobs
- query start locations and scheduled-token spans
- hidden states and multimodal output tensors
- KV-connector and encoder-cache outputs captured for the step

CUDA tensor cloning is required because CUDA Graph and model output buffers can
be reused by the next forward pass. The dedicated copy stream and pinned host
buffers make the D2H transfer asynchronous; the snapshot retains its cloned
CUDA sources until the transfer event completes.

### Live Runner State and Ownership

The complete builder input is not a detached snapshot. Connector output state
remains runner-owned: `get_omni_connector_output()` drains live, per-cycle
connector signals after the streaming payload is built. Correctness therefore
depends on that builder being the only consumer that drains connector signals
for its output cycle. Receive-side connector state written by the background
receiver is coordinated by the connector mixin's `_lock`.
`OmniAsyncGPUModelRunnerOutput.get_output()` joins the builder and is the
completion and exception boundary before the materialized output is consumed.

The shared output builder also contains a full-payload accumulation branch
that reads `self.requests`. That branch is not reachable when async Omni output
materialization is enabled: this feature requires `async_chunk`, while
`should_accumulate_full_payload_output()` returns `False` whenever
`async_chunk` is enabled. The feature path partitions each step's payload into
streaming inter-stage and client handoffs instead.

### Output Builder

The background builder performs the work that previously ran inline:

- resolves which requests need downstream payloads
- converts hidden and multimodal tensors into per-request CPU payloads
- applies model-specific payload processing
- partitions per-step payloads into inter-stage and client streams
- creates the tensor-only `multimodal_outputs` wire payload
- drains live connector readiness signals after building the streaming payload
- constructs the final `OmniModelRunnerOutput`

Input-side connector operations remain synchronous with model execution. In
particular, receiving inputs and flushing previously completed connector
outputs are not deferred because they affect scheduler-visible request state.

### Qwen3-Omni Stage Behavior

| Stage | Async output behavior | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Thinker | Snapshots hidden states and multimodal outputs; builds the downstream payload in the background | The Talker needs the payload, but the next Thinker decode step only needs sampled-token feedback |
| Talker | Runs lightweight postprocess eagerly; snapshots codec outputs; omits hidden states from the downstream payload | `hidden_states.last` is needed by the next Talker step, while Code2Wav only needs codec codes |
| Code2Wav | Uses the normal generation-stage output path | Code2Wav is not executed by `GPUARModelRunner` |

The Qwen3-TTS Talker follows the same pattern as the Qwen3-Omni Talker:
postprocess runs eagerly because the next decode step needs its updated state,
while codec payload construction runs asynchronously. Its Code2Wav stage also
uses the normal generation-stage path.

## Enabling the Feature

There is no separate `async_omni_output` command-line or YAML option. The
feature is selected automatically for model stages that opt in when the runtime
conditions are safe. On the validated CUDA and ROCm configurations, using the
bundled deployment profile is enough to turn it on for the supported
Qwen3-Omni and Qwen3-TTS pipelines. The selection logic has no CUDA/ROCm-only
guard; see [Compatibility and Fallbacks](#compatibility-and-fallbacks) for the
other platform paths. The same profile does not enable background Omni
materialization on Ascend NPU.

### Example 1: Qwen3-Omni

Start the full Qwen3-Omni pipeline:

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct \
  --omni \
  --port 8091
```

The model registry automatically loads
`vllm_omni/deploy/qwen3_omni_moe.yaml`. Its relevant settings are:

```yaml
async_chunk: true

stages:
  - stage_id: 0  # Thinker
    enable_prefix_caching: false
    # async_scheduling defaults to true for AR stages

  - stage_id: 1  # Talker
    enable_prefix_caching: false
    # async_scheduling defaults to true for AR stages

  - stage_id: 2  # Code2Wav
    enable_prefix_caching: false
    async_scheduling: false
```

With this profile, async output materialization activates automatically for:

- **Stage 0, Thinker**: Defers hidden-state and multimodal payload
  construction.
- **Stage 1, Talker**: Defers codec payload construction after eagerly
  updating its decode state.

Stage 2 does not use this feature because Code2Wav is not an AR stage.

### Example 2: Qwen3-TTS

Start Qwen3-TTS with any checkpoint that uses the Qwen3-TTS Talker pipeline.
For example:

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice \
  --omni \
  --port 8091
```

The model registry automatically loads `vllm_omni/deploy/qwen3_tts.yaml`. Its
relevant settings are:

```yaml
async_chunk: true

stages:
  - stage_id: 0  # Talker
    async_scheduling: true
    enable_prefix_caching: false

  - stage_id: 1  # Code2Wav
    enable_prefix_caching: false
```

Async output materialization activates only for Stage 0, the AR Talker. The
Talker keeps the state required by its next decode step on the GPU, skips an
unnecessary hidden-state D2H copy, and builds the codec payload for Code2Wav in
the background. Stage 1 uses the generation-stage output path.

The same behavior applies to the Base and VoiceDesign Qwen3-TTS checkpoints
because they use the same Talker implementation.

input.rationale: vLLM-Omni 是在 vLLM 基础上扩展的「全模态（omni-modality）推理与服务框架」，其核心特色是 AR+DiT 多阶段、全解耦（OmniConnector + Orchestrator）的运行时。学习路线遵循「先会用 → 再懂机制 → 后能扩展」的递进。入门层 U1 从项目定位、安装、源码地图到离线/在线快速上手，让读者先跑通第一个模型；U2 讲清 vLLM-Omni 如何通过 patch.py、配置体系、输入输出数据结构扩展 vLLM，这是理解整个项目的地基。进阶层用三个单元分别拆解三大核心子系统：U3 多阶段运行时与编排（AsyncOmniEngine/Orchestrator/Stage 进程/OmniConnector/OmniCoordinator），U4 AR 模块（scheduler/worker/model runner/多模态输出/解码加速），U5 Diffusion 模块（engine/sched/executor/worker/pipeline），对应架构图中的 Entrypoints、AR、Diffusion、OmniConnector；U6 讲在线服务 API。专家层 U7 集中讲 Diffusion 加速（注意力后端/并行注意力/缓存/并行策略/请求级与连续批处理），U8 讲量化、多硬件平台与性能剖析，U9 讲三类模型（Diffusion / Omni 多阶段 / TTS）的扩展开发与实验特性，U10 讲 L1–L5 测试体系与 CI 工程实践。讲义间依赖按「入门→机制→子系统→加速→扩展→工程」串成线性主干，每个加速/扩展主题都依赖其对应的子系统讲义，确保读者始终结合真实源码循序渐进。本次增量（900a7f0 → 5215e03a）共 4 个 PR：#5715 将版本对齐到 v0.26.0 并更新 README/安装文档（新增 MiniMax H3、MiniCPM-o 4.5、全双工实时服务、NPU 安装步骤改写），影响 u1-l1、u1-l2，作 update；#5461「[1/N] Scheduler 重构」将 OmniARScheduler/OmniGenerationScheduler 的重复逻辑上提到共享的 OmniSchedulerMixin 并建立显式生命周期契约（两调度器类与各自的快路径/富化概念均保留），故 u4-l2 作 update 并补充 mixin；#5610 新增「Async Omni Output Materialization」设计文档，把 OmniModelRunnerOutput 的 CPU 侧构造移出 AR 解码关键路径（后台 builder + D2H 重叠），属新增重要机制，故在 U4 新增 u4-l4；#5740 仅修复 MiniMax H3 测试 URL，无讲义影响。其余讲义对应代码在本次窗口未变，全部 keep。

data.head: 5215e03a91adecbb5ffece29aa74360a7569d0c5
data.rationale: vLLM-Omni 是在 vLLM 基础上扩展的「全模态（omni-modality）推理与服务框架」，其核心特色是 AR+DiT 多阶段、全解耦（OmniConnector + Orchestrator）的运行时。学习路线遵循「先会用 → 再懂机制 → 后能扩展」的递进。入门层 U1 从项目定位、安装、源码地图到离线/在线快速上手，让读者先跑通第一个模型；U2 讲清 vLLM-Omni 如何通过 patch.py、配置体系、输入输出数据结构扩展 vLLM，这是理解整个项目的地基。进阶层用三个单元分别拆解三大核心子系统：U3 多阶段运行时与编排（AsyncOmniEngine/Orchestrator/Stage 进程/OmniConnector/OmniCoordinator），U4 AR 模块（scheduler/worker/model runner/多模态输出/解码加速），U5 Diffusion 模块（engine/sched/executor/worker/pipeline），对应架构图中的 Entrypoints、AR、Diffusion、OmniConnector；U6 讲在线服务 API。专家层 U7 集中讲 Diffusion 加速（注意力后端/并行注意力/缓存/并行策略/请求级与连续批处理），U8 讲量化、多硬件平台与性能剖析，U9 讲三类模型（Diffusion / Omni 多阶段 / TTS）的扩展开发与实验特性，U10 讲 L1–L5 测试体系与 CI 工程实践。讲义间依赖按「入门→机制→子系统→加速→扩展→工程」串成线性主干，每个加速/扩展主题都依赖其对应的子系统讲义，确保读者始终结合真实源码循序渐进。本次增量（900a7f0 → 5215e03a）共 4 个 PR：#5715 将版本对齐到 v0.26.0 并更新 README/安装文档（新增 MiniMax H3、MiniCPM-o 4.5、全双工实时服务、NPU 安装步骤改写），影响 u1-l1、u1-l2，作 update；#5461「[1/N] Scheduler 重构」将 OmniARScheduler/OmniGenerationScheduler 的重复逻辑上提到共享的 OmniSchedulerMixin 并建立显式生命周期契约（两调度器类与各自的快路径/富化概念均保留），故 u4-l2 作 update 并补充 mixin；#5610 新增「Async Omni Output Materialization」设计文档，把 OmniModelRunnerOutput 的 CPU 侧构造移出 AR 解码关键路径（后台 builder + D2H 重叠），属新增重要机制，故在 U4 新增 u4-l4；#5740 仅修复 MiniMax H3 测试 URL，无讲义影响。其余讲义对应代码在本次窗口未变，全部 keep。

理解该特性依赖 async_chunk 自动启用、Thinker/Talker/Code2Wav 各 stage 的差异化行为，以及 Ascend NPU 因走独立 NPUARModelRunner 仍同步构造的原因
